name: Endnotes
description: A collection of Endnote objects that represents all the endnotes in a selection, range, or document.
remarks: Use the Endnotes property to return the Endnotes collection. The following example sets the location of endnotes in the active document. Use the Add method to add an endnote to the Endnotes collection. The following example adds an endnote immediately after the selection. Use Endnotes (Index), where Index is the index number, to return a single Endnote object. The index number represents the position of the endnote in a selection, range, or document. The following example applies red formatting to the first endnote in the selection.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of endnotes in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Endnotes object.

properties.name: Location
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of all endnotes. Read/write WdEndnoteLocation. .

properties.name: NumberStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the number style. Read/write WdNoteNumberStyle.

properties.name: StartingNumber
properties.description: Returns or sets the starting note number, line number, or page number. Read/write Long.

properties.name: NumberingRule
properties.description: Returns or sets the way endnotes are numbered after page breaks or section breaks. Read/write WdNumberingRule.

properties.name: Separator
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the endnote separator.

properties.name: ContinuationSeparator
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the endnote continuation separator. Read-only.

properties.name: ContinuationNotice
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the endnote continuation notice. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual Endnote object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Range As Range, [Reference As Variant], [Text As Variant]) As Endnote
methods.description: Returns an Endnote object that represents an endnote added to a range.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range marked for the endnote or footnote. This can be a collapsed range.

parameters.name: Reference
parameters.description: The text for the custom reference mark. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Word inserts an automatically-numbered reference mark.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text of the endnote or footnote.

methods.name: SwapWithFootnotes
methods.description: Converts all endnotes in a document to footnotes and vice versa.

methods.name: ResetSeparator
methods.description: Resets the endnote separator to the default separator.

methods.name: ResetContinuationSeparator
methods.description: Resets the endnote continuation separator to the default separator.

methods.name: ResetContinuationNotice
methods.description: Resets the endnote continuation notice to the default notice.
